fruits.extendedStory: Ljubljana's castle has watched over the old town since around the year 900. For centuries a fire guard lived in its tower. When flames appeared he fired a cannon to warn everyone below. Climb the lookout tower today for the view. Its very top stands exactly 400 metres above the sea.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Ljubljanas Burg wacht seit ungefähr dem Jahr 900 über die Altstadt. Jahrhundertelang wohnte ein Feuerwächter in ihrem Turm. Wenn Flammen auftauchten, feuerte er eine Kanone ab, um alle unten zu warnen. Steig heute für die Aussicht auf den Aussichtsturm. Seine Spitze liegt genau 400 Meter über dem Meer.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Ljubljana's castle has watched over the old town since around the year 900. For centuries a fire guard lived in its tower. When flames appeared he fired a cannon to warn everyone below. Climb the lookout tower today for the view. Its very top stands exactly 400 metres above the sea.

localizedStory.de: Oben auf der Burg hielt einst ein Wächter vom Turm aus Ausschau. Brach unten ein Feuer aus, feuerte er eine Kanone ab, um zu warnen.
localizedStory.en: Up at the castle, a fire guard once watched from the tower. If flames rose below, he fired a cannon to warn the city.

fruits.name: Ljubljanski grad
fruits.story: Up at the castle, a fire guard once watched from the tower. If flames rose below, he fired a cannon to warn the city.

fruits.extendedStory: Look up as you stand here and you will notice soft, flowing lines across the buildings. This is the Art Nouveau style, full of gentle curves and ornament. One of the grand fronts was designed by the architect Edvard Ravnikar. Slow down and let your eyes climb from the shop windows to the rooftops.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Schau dich hier um und du entdeckst weiche, fließende Linien an den Häusern. Das ist der Jugendstil, voller sanfter Rundungen und Verzierungen. Eine der prächtigen Fassaden entwarf der Architekt Edvard Ravnikar. Lass deinen Blick in Ruhe von den Schaufenstern bis hinauf zu den Dächern wandern.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Look up as you stand here and you will notice soft, flowing lines across the buildings. This is the Art Nouveau style, full of gentle curves and ornament. One of the grand fronts was designed by the architect Edvard Ravnikar. Slow down and let your eyes climb from the shop windows to the rooftops.

localizedStory.de: Dieser Platz trägt den Namen von France Prešeren, ein lebendiger Ort in Ljubljana, um Freunde zu treffen und dem Tag zuzusehen.
localizedStory.en: People gather on this square named for the poet France Prešeren, meeting under buildings dressed in flowing Art Nouveau curves.

fruits.name: Prešernov trg
fruits.story: People gather on this square named for the poet France Prešeren, meeting under buildings dressed in flowing Art Nouveau curves.

fruits.extendedStory: The architect Jože Plečnik designed this library as a journey toward knowledge. Inside, a grand dark staircase climbs upward past 32 pillars of black Podpeč marble. The steps feel serious and quiet, like the hush of a reading room. Climb them slowly and imagine the winged horse from the door carrying you up toward the books.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Architekt Jože Plečnik entwarf diese Bibliothek als einen Weg zum Wissen. Drinnen steigt eine große, dunkle Treppe an 32 Säulen aus schwarzem Podpeč-Marmor empor. Die Stufen wirken ernst und still, wie die Ruhe eines Lesesaals. Steig langsam hinauf und stell dir vor, das geflügelte Pferd vom Tor trägt dich hoch zu den Büchern.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The architect Jože Plečnik designed this library as a journey toward knowledge. Inside, a grand dark staircase climbs upward past 32 pillars of black Podpeč marble. The steps feel serious and quiet, like the hush of a reading room. Climb them slowly and imagine the winged horse from the door carrying you up toward the books.

localizedStory.de: Jeder Griff am Haupttor der Bibliothek ist ein Kopf des Pegasus, des geflügelten Pferdes, das die Leser zum Wissen führt.
localizedStory.en: Each handle on the library's main door is a head of Pegasus, the winged horse, guiding readers toward knowledge.

fruits.name: Narodna in univerzitetna knjižnica
fruits.story: Each handle on the library's main door is a head of Pegasus, the winged horse, guiding readers toward knowledge.

fruits.extendedStory: This national gallery opened its doors in 1918. For a long time the Robba Fountain stood outdoors on its square, until a fresh copy took its place there in 2006. The delicate original was then carried inside these walls, safe from wind and rain. So the fountain out on the square and the one resting in here are two versions of the same work.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Diese Nationalgalerie öffnete ihre Türen im Jahr 1918. Lange Zeit stand der Robba-Brunnen draußen auf seinem Platz, bis 2006 eine frische Kopie dort seinen Platz einnahm. Das empfindliche Original wurde dann in diese Mauern getragen, geschützt vor Wind und Regen. So sind der Brunnen draußen auf dem Platz und der hier drinnen zwei Fassungen desselben Werks.
localizedExtendedStory.en: This national gallery opened its doors in 1918. For a long time the Robba Fountain stood outdoors on its square, until a fresh copy took its place there in 2006. The delicate original was then carried inside these walls, safe from wind and rain. So the fountain out on the square and the one resting in here are two versions of the same work.

localizedStory.de: Tritt ein und du triffst den echten Robba-Brunnen: Sein restauriertes Original wurde 2008 in diese Galerie gebracht.
localizedStory.en: Step inside and you can meet the real Robba Fountain: its restored original was brought into this gallery in 2008.

fruits.name: Narodna galerija
fruits.story: Step inside and you can meet the real Robba Fountain: its restored original was brought into this gallery in 2008.

localizedStory.de: Diese Fußgängerbrücke weitet sich in der Mitte zu einer kleinen Aussichtsplattform. Ihr Name stammt vom alten Getreideplatz, wo in den 1800er Jahren Getreide gehandelt wurde.
localizedStory.en: This footbridge widens at its middle into a lookout platform. It is named for the old Grain Square where grain was sold in the 1800s.

fruits.name: Žitni most
fruits.story: This footbridge widens at its middle into a lookout platform. It is named for the old Grain Square where grain was sold in the 1800s.

localizedStory.de: 1743 erbaut, hebt dieser Brunnen einen steinernen Obelisken zehn Meter in die Höhe über der Altstadt, umringt von Marmorfiguren.
localizedStory.en: Three carved rivermen guard a slim marble spire that shoots ten metres into the air.

fruits.name: Robbov vodnjak
fruits.story: Three carved rivermen guard a slim marble spire that shoots ten metres into the air.

localizedStory.de: Die Bronzestatue des Dichters Valentin Vodnik war das erste öffentliche Denkmal für Slowenien, enthüllt 1889.
localizedStory.en: The bronze statue of the poet Valentin Vodnik here was the first public monument to honour Slovenia, unveiled in 1889.

fruits.name: Vodnikov trg
fruits.story: The bronze statue of the poet Valentin Vodnik here was the first public monument to honour Slovenia, unveiled in 1889.

localizedStory.de: Dieser Brunnen zeigt Herkules im Ringkampf mit einem Löwen. Das Original steht heute im Rathaus, eine Kopie von 1991 steht hier im Freien.
localizedStory.en: This fountain shows Hercules wrestling a lion. The original now stands inside the Town Hall, and a copy from 1991 stands here outdoors.

fruits.name: Herkulov vodnjak
fruits.story: This fountain shows Hercules wrestling a lion. The original now stands inside the Town Hall, and a copy from 1991 stands here outdoors.
